explication: Anubis MCP is an Elixir SDK for MCP clients and servers. A client process sends operations over STDIO or Streamable HTTP; a server transport delivers messages to sessions, whose handlers dispatch tools, resources, prompts, and other protocol operations. Servers can register components at compile time or dynamically, and support authorization, task handling, and persistent sessions. The README documents the end-to-end setup; some subsystem links below are dashed because their implementation was not shown in excerpts.
